info.name: Admin Management API Tests
info.description: Test cases for admin panel endpoints including user management and system statistics

item.name: Get System Statistics
item.tests: pm.test('Status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); }); pm.test('Response has system stats', function () { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.data).to.have.property('total_users'); pm.expect(json.data).to.have.property('total_roomspaces'); pm.expect(json.data).to.have.property('total_expenses'); });

item.name: Get All Users
item.tests: pm.test('Status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); }); pm.test('Response has users array', function () { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.data).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(json.pagination).to.have.property('total'); });

item.name: Search Users
item.tests: pm.test('Status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); }); pm.test('Response has filtered users', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data).to.be.an('array'); });

item.name: Get User Details
item.tests: pm.test('Status code is 200 or 404', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 404]); }); if (pm.response.code === 200) { pm.test('Response has user details', function () { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.data).to.have.property('user'); pm.expect(json.data).to.have.property('roomspace_count'); }); }

item.name: Check User Ban Status
item.tests: pm.test('Status code is 200 or 404', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 404]); }); if (pm.response.code === 200) { pm.test('Response has ban status', function () { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('is_banned'); }); }

item.name: Ban User
item.tests: pm.test('Status code is 200 or 404', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 404]); }); if (pm.response.code === 200) { pm.test('User banned successfully', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include('banned'); }); }

item.name: Unban User
item.tests: pm.test('Status code is 200 or 404', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 404]); }); if (pm.response.code === 200) { pm.test('User unbanned successfully', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include('unbanned'); }); }

item.name: Get Users with Large Limit
item.tests: pm.test('Status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); }); pm.test('Response handles large limit', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data).to.be.an('array'); });
